_doc: The scripted captain watches ships pass over one another (owner, 2026-11-09: "in SFC smaller ships would change their height and fly above larger ships so that ships wouldnt clip inside of each other"): a battle with wingmen, the fleets let close while stills are taken, then fought out. A smaller ship (or of two the same length, the one later in the battle's order, never the ship you command) is drawn clear above a ship it overlaps (BattleView.Stack). In a window, snap saves stills into docs/screenshots/game/stacking/.
